vetSays.line: 🛡️ Oscar, Eric, Somchai and Ava met them at the door — 4 put down. Oscar, Eric, Somchai, Ava are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oscar just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oluwadamilare just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Oscar, Eric, Oluwadamilare and Chae-yoon met them at the door — 4 put down. Oscar, Eric, Chae-yoon are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Henry was hunting The Terms of Service — but The Strike they just met is the bigger beast, the kind that makes veterans. The hunt turns to The Strike instead."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oluwadamilare had no trail — but The Audit they just met is the bigger beast, the kind that makes veterans. The hunt turns to The Audit instead."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Eduardo met them at the door — 1 put down. Eduardo is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Anton just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Eduardo just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Eduardo met them at the door — 1 put down. Eduardo is hurt.

Eduardo: "Eduardo and Ava blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 2 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."
